description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI screen named ConnectTabScreen, which manages gateway connection settings, displays connection status, and provides controls for setup code, manual host/port/TLS, and advanced options. It integrates with a ViewModel, handles user input, and displays diagnostics.

classes.name: ConnectInputMode
classes.description: Enum class to switch between setup code and manual connection modes.

methods.name: MethodChip
methods.description: Composable for a selectable method option button, indicating active state.

methods.description: Composable for a quick preset input button.

methods.description: Displays a command in a styled block with copy-ready text.
